### Kolmogorov's Continuity Lemma

:::{.theorem data-title="Kolmogorov's Continuity Lemma"}

Let $\{  X_{t},t\geq 0 \}$ be a stochastic process such that for all $T^*>0$
there exist $\alpha, \beta, C>0$ such that
$$
\mathbb{E}[\lvert X_{t+h}-X_{t} \rvert^\alpha ]\leq Ch^{1+\beta},
$$
for $h>0$ and $0 < t<T^*-h$. Then there exists a continuous version of $X$.

:::

The proof can be found in Chapter 8 of
[[probability-theory-and-examples-durrett-pdf]].
